topic: Corporate Rebels 1-60 · higher purpose motivates employees (2/6)

passage.text: This is not new information; for decades, research has shown that pursuing a higher purpose motivates people more strongly than pursuing higher profit. Author Daniel Pink, known for his book Drive: The Surprising Truth about What Motivates Us, supports this view. He argues that the question of what difference one makes in the world is essential, and that being aware of one's contribution is extremely motivating.

taps.prompt: What is the main idea of the text?
taps.correct: Research shows that meaningful purpose motivates employees more effectively than profit alone.
wrong: Higher profits are the most effective way to motivate employees.
Daniel Pink invented the concept of motivation in the workplace.
